CONCRETE MIX DESIGN SUBMITTAL · Submittal 03 30 00-01
Project: CEM4644 practice project (fictional) · Supplier: Practice Ready-Mix Co. (fictional), Plant 2
Mix ID: 3000-4-AE-01 · Intended use: Foundation walls (exterior)

Design data
Specified compressive strength: 3000 psi at 28 days (required average strength f'cr = 4200 psi, from field records)
Batch weights per cubic yard (saturated surface-dry aggregates):
  Portland cement, ASTM C150 Type I/II: 500 lb
  Fly ash, ASTM C618 Class F: 75 lb
  Total cementitious materials: 575 lb
  Water: 293 lb
  Coarse aggregate, ASTM C33, nominal maximum size 3/4 in: 1828 lb
  Fine aggregate, ASTM C33 natural sand: 1271 lb
Water-cementitious materials ratio (w/cm): 0.51
Admixtures: air-entraining admixture, ASTM C260, 0.6 oz per 100 lb cementitious; water-reducing admixture, ASTM C494 Type A, 4 oz per 100 lb cementitious
Target slump: 4 in (ASTM C143)
Target total air content: 2.5 percent (ASTM C231)
Unit weight: 143.3 lb per cubic foot

MORTAR AND GROUT MIX SUBMITTAL · Submittal 04 20 00-01
Project: CEM4644 practice project (fictional) · Supplier: Practice Masonry Supply (fictional)
Intended use: Exterior walls

Mortar
Specification: ASTM C270, Type N, proportion specification
Cementitious materials: portland cement (ASTM C150 Type I) and hydrated lime (ASTM C207 Type S)
Aggregate: masonry sand, ASTM C144
Admixtures: none
Batching: field-batched by volume with measuring boxes

Grout
Specification: ASTM C476, coarse grout, ready-mixed
Grout consistency: conventional grout, slump 6 in (ASTM C143)
Compressive strength: 3000 psi at 28 days (ASTM C1019, three specimens, average)
